recipe.title: Spanish lentil stew with vegetables
steps: Rinse the lentils. Dice the carrot, pepper and onion small.
Put the lentils and vegetables in a large pot with water to cover. Simmer for 30 to 35 minutes until soft.
Warm the oil in a small pan. Add the chopped garlic and the paprika for 30 seconds.
Stir the sofrito into the stew and add salt.
Split into 4 containers and store in the fridge. Reheat in the microwave.
